_doc: The canonical skeleton every race pack and every item is described against.
See docs/rigging_rewrite.md. A FRAME is {o, ax, lx, ly[, ly_neg]} in pixels;
races and items both carry frames with the names listed here, and fitting an
item is mapping its points from its own frame to the race's frame of the same name.
_l/_r are IMAGE left/right; every pack faces south, so _r is the main hand.

frames.torso: origin midway between the shoulder seams, axis along the shoulder line; lx = half shoulder span, ly = trunk depth toward the front, ly_neg = toward the back
frames.back: the trunk's rear edge (torso origin pushed back by ly_neg), same axis and lx: where capes and packs hang
frames.upperarm_l: shoulder seam -> elbow seam; lx = length, ly = mean half-thickness
frames.grip_l: palm centre, axis along the hand; lx = ly = pack px per world px
frames.head: largest circle inside the head label (ears, horns, beards stick out of it); lx = ly = radius
frames.head_full: bounding box of the whole head label
frames.foot_l: bounding box of the foot label; lx/ly = half width/height
frames.leg_l: optional: hip -> ankle, only on races whose legs show from above
